services.title: Five disciplines, one standard.
services.intro: Each service answers one clear objective: lift a weight off you, and give you back your time.

events.name: Event planning
events.objective: Lift the weight of organising off your family.
events.title: Your event, without the load.
events.body: From birthdays to large family gatherings, we take on the design, the suppliers, the schedule and the day itself. You stay the host; we carry everything else.

coaching.name: Teen coaching
coaching.objective: Help your teenager through the adolescent crisis and build a better future.
coaching.title: Through adolescence, and stronger for it.
coaching.body: Patient, structured, confidential support: confidence, direction, family relationships, study method. We work with the teenager, and with the parents.

home.name: Housekeeping and decoration
home.objective: Create beauty and calm in your homes and your offices.
home.title: A clean home, a quiet mind.
home.body: A regular visit, a consistent team, a standard that doesn't move. And if you'd like it, a decorator's eye — so the space isn't only clean, but beautiful.

property.name: Property management
property.short: Airbnb, apartments, property at a distance
property.objective: Let you collect your rent without the hassle.
property.title: Your property, in good hands.
property.body: For owners far from their property, or simply too busy: welcoming tenants, upkeep, small repairs, rent tracking and a regular report. You collect; we keep watch.

sourcing.name: Purchase facilitation
sourcing.objective: Let you do your shopping in comfort.
sourcing.title: What you need, found and delivered.
sourcing.body: Online or in local markets, we search, compare, negotiate and deliver. Tell us what you're looking for and we'll come back with a clear proposal.

hero.title: Who are we?
hero.intro: Facility is your everyday partner in Bujumbura, for families, homes and businesses. We organise your events, from weddings and dowry ceremonies to birthdays and retreats, and we take on what weighs on your days: decorating and cleaning your spaces, managing your rental properties, doing your shopping. We also create spaces and stays where teenagers learn about themselves and grow. One point of contact, one standard, and one goal: to make your life lighter.
hero.photoAlt: Dusenge Kathia Daslim, CEO of Facility, in conversation with two women.
hero.vision: We create comfort, wellbeing and joy — in the family and everywhere else.

values.title: Our values
values.intro: Responsibility, integrity, excellence and service — to make your life easy.

responsibility.name: Responsibility
responsibility.body: What you entrust to us becomes our business. We keep our commitments, from the first conversation to the final detail.

integrity.name: Integrity
integrity.body: Clear quotes, promises kept, no surprises. We tell you what is possible, and what is not.

excellence.name: Excellence
excellence.body: Care for detail, every single time. A celebration or a cleaning visit: the same standard, and it doesn't move.

service.name: Service
service.body: Available, attentive, thoughtful. We measure our success by the “wow” on your face.

founder.photoAlt: Portrait of Dusenge Kathia Daslim, CEO of Facility.
founder.quote: Entrusting us with part of your everyday life is an act of trust. We look after it as if it were our own.
founder.story1: Facility was born from something I saw far too often around me: in every family, one person carries everything. The celebration to organise, the home to keep, a property to rent out from afar, a teenager searching for their place — and almost no time left for themselves.
founder.story2: I wanted those people to finally have someone they could count on: a single partner, reliable and caring, who takes things in hand with the same care as someone close to them. That is how Facility was born, here in Bujumbura.
founder.story3: Today, every request is followed personally and every commitment is kept. You tell us what is weighing on you; we take care of it. And our finest reward is still that “wow” on your face.
